# smart-immunizations-annexes

The web annexes this IG's pages load on demand (bean folio-assistant-fm9n; owner, 2026-10-10, option 2a: the data dictionary in the knowledge graph, loaded dynamically, not the full workbook). `annexes.json` (`ig-annexes/v1`) puts `dak/dak-data-dictionary.json` on `dictionary.md`, showing six columns and opening the rest per row. fhir-harness's IG site build finds it through this `ig-annex` declaration, both `stage-ig-sites` for an index and `ig-repo-site.ts compose` for this repository's own site. It is a directory of its own, not `fhir-artifact-index/`, because an IG repository commits no artefact index (fhir-harness#124; owner, 2026-10-24, option B).

Part of [WHO SMART Guidelines — Immunizations](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-immunizations-annexes`, holding `ig-annex`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`annexes.json`](annexes.json) | data |  |
| [`dak/`](dak/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
